timeline.text: Within days of launching my site, my contact form was getting buried under 50 spam messages a day — SEO offers, casino links, crypto junk.
I didn't want to slap a CAPTCHA on it and make every real visitor feel like a suspect.
So I built a three-layer trap inside one Edge Function: a hidden field, a timing check, and a rate limit.
Bots trip one of the three instantly; real people never even notice it's there.
